additions.distinctness_review: Searched sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json and identity-mapping.json of the 517-site base for Carbon Node, Panther Creek, Nesquehoning, Keel, PAD130057 and E1302226 with no match other than the unrelated Louisiana radio station domain 710keel.com in a Shreveport news citation. The nearest existing site is Amazon's Salem Township Innovation Campus, 33.8 km away; no Carbon County site is listed.

locator.identity_review: DEP's 19 August notice names the proposed Carbon Node East data center in Nesquehoning and its applications E1302226-001 and PAD130057; DEP's tracker lists the same applications under project 10000007, Carbon Node East / Panther Creek (Keel Infrastructure), in Nesquehoning Borough. The county parcel service returns exactly two parcels owned by Carbon Node East Property LLC, deeded on 25 March 2026, and DEP's own project point lies 59 m west of parcel 114-44-A9A. The DEP point, whose meaning DEP does not document, and the borough centre are not used as the locator.
locator.precision: Centroid of the union of the two nearly contiguous Carbon County parcels owned by Carbon Node East Property LLC (114-44-A5.10A and 114-44-A9A on Industrial Road, 197.9 computed acres, about 1.8 by 1.0 km); it falls inside 114-44-A5.10A. It locates the project property, not a building, a surveyed campus boundary or a works extent.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county service publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid represents a property of roughly 1.8 by 1.0 km.

status.summary: On 19 August 2026 Pennsylvania DEP announced a public meeting and hearing for the proposed Carbon Node East data center in Nesquehoning, Carbon County, on its pending Water Obstruction and Encroachment (E1302226-001) and Individual NPDES (PAD130057) permit applications, with Carbon Node East Development, LLC presenting. DEP's tracker lists the project as under review with all permits pending. No issued permit, site works or construction is established.

additions.successor_review: The tracker export of 16 October still lists the project as under review with every permit pending, after the 20 August hearing; no issued permit, groundbreaking, pause or withdrawal was found. The status is kept at announced.
